issues.description: Method getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): the problem statement UML (problem_statement.md) declares getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() with return type int, but the template comment and the solution implementation use a double return type. Specifically, problem_statement.md line 72 shows '+getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): int', while template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 17 contains the comment '// Return type: double for precise calculation' and solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java defines 'public double getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor()'. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected return type and lead to incorrect implementations or failing tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across all materials. Prefer updating the problem statement UML and any descriptive text to specify a double return type for getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(), since a double preserves fractional students-per-tutor calculations; alternatively, if integers are intended, change the template comment and solution method signature to return int and document the rounding behavior. Update the UML line, the task description, and any template comments to match the chosen type.
